title: Ordering and delivery screens

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Preserve clarity through a transaction so customers can understand food choice, timing and completion.
strategic_value: Shared typography and restrained illustration can keep Sweetgreen recognizable beyond promotional screens.
demonstration: Three upright phones show a bowl order, delivery-time selection and a delivery confirmation with a moving illustrated ingredient, set against a landscape.
practical_value: Compare which brand elements remain useful across selection, scheduling and confirmation.

content_islands.name: Order
content_islands.spec: Place the food and order controls in the left phone.

content_islands.name: Schedule
content_islands.spec: Use the middle phone for delivery-time options.

content_islands.name: Confirmation
content_islands.spec: Use the right phone for the completed-order message and animated illustration.

reference_purposes.Application: Three screens demonstrate different stages of an ordering flow.
reference_purposes.Expression: The confirmation uses a moving illustrated ingredient while the practical screens remain restrained.
